input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. ... 28.2 The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction, and each Party irrevocably submits to personal jurisdiction and waives any objection based on venue or inconvenient forum.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, which is exactly the playbook's preferred position. A document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no foreign-seated arbitration risk despite the Vendor being an English Ltd. The carve-out in 28.2 permitting temporary injunctive relief in another court is mutual and narrow (confidential information / IP) and does not displace the exclusive court venue; the pre-filing executive escalation in 28.3 expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings. No redline required.
